mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS signup_id, s.status AS status, si.user_id AS student_user_id, a.id AS activity_id, a.title AS activity_title, a.org_id AS activity_org_id, o.org_name AS activity_org_name FROM activity_signup s JOIN volunteer_activity a ON a.id = s.activity_id JOIN student_info si ON si.id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN org_info o ON o.id = a.org_id WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND a.deleted = 0 AND s.id = #{signupId}
